title: The Odiyan Contracts
heat: Open door, moderate: 2 to 3 explicit scenes per book, each changing the bargain between them

books.central_question: Will Neela kill the husband she was sold to?
books.hinge: The guild's payment writ for Devan's death bears the queen's own seal.

books.central_question: Can they steal the guild's ledger without becoming its new masters?
books.hinge: The ledger's missing pages are odiyans sold to the crown: the queen's own guard are odiyans, held in her secret crown leaf.

books.central_question: Can they free every odiyan, even the queen's guard, if it leaves Varanad without its night-guard as Thurai raiders land?
books.hinge: A Thurai envoy asks to hire the Night Company, bringing a rogue odiyan who was never in any ledger.
